title: English referent-colour pool — credential-parity assembly (PROPOSED)
status: PROPOSED — concludes nothing. Registration ⚑ her breaking (word_latent_en_referent_color_registration_54.md); run ⚑ her go.
doctrine: CREDENTIAL-PARITY: EN rulers certify against EN truth only. TRUTH = Buchanan-2019 colour-feature production >= 0.20 OR Lancaster visual rule A. Witnesses = candidate-generators (her demotion ruling).
witness_rule: colour family named in any NOUN-sense definition (up to first ';', [a-z]+ tokens); ported from definition_witness_en_53, nltk WordNet 3.0; PARITY reproduces the committed 8 COCO fires
realized_rule: primary gloss names it a colour term via `<family|chromatic> colour` frame OR lemma is a colour family term (declared; consequence: colour words realize, referent nouns do not)
ensemble_law: WordNet sister terms (co-hyponyms), single-word lowercased lemmas minus w, minus colour-charged; F_MIN floor applied in the scorer; fallback = sit out (no invented siblings)
control_sampling_law: seeded (seed 48) sample of 100 Leipzig-frequent WordNet nouns (top 6000 tokens, count >= 50) with no witness fire, no Buchanan colour feature, not colour-charged

sense_tiers.law: dual-pool, her 'fire both' (07-22): sense_tier='primary' iff the witness fires on the PRIMARY noun sense; else 'any_sense_only' (sub-flag definition_fire: 'non_primary_only' vs 'none' for pixel-triggered). The scorer scores the union once, publishes STRICT (primary) + WIDE (all) confusion tables.

reflective_adjacent.flag: the any_sense_only class is REFLECTIVE-ADJACENT (colour via associative leap, not referent-fact or glyph); its differential behaviour between the strict and wide tables is itself a finding feeding the reflective-candidate column.
reflective_adjacent.her_reader_datum_verbatim: monarch and jet are "somewhat reflective-color… those two are pretty colors to me"
reflective_adjacent.mechanical_mixture_note: the tier also holds sense-order artifacts (banana: the fruit gloss is sense-2 behind the herb) and pixel-triggered no-definition-fire members (pizza) — distinguishable via definition_fire.
reflective_adjacent.authority_note: field-owner ruling, coordinator-relayed; logged for provenance, NOT user authorization.
